newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Molson is a good investment - Foster's.
newsitem.headline: Molson is a good investment - Foster's.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday that its 40 percent owned Molson Breweries, remained an attractive investment despite a string of recent problems at the Canadian brewer.

Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel descibed Molson's performance over the six months to December 31 as mixed, but said its earnings before interest and tax of A$39.7 million represented a strong return on capital.
"The rate of return to Foster's Brewing Group means it retains its attractiveness as an investment. There is no doubt about that," Kunkel told reporters.
Clear evidence as emerged that the erosion of Molson's market share in Canada had stopped.

Molson has lost market share in Quebec, Canada, it is involved in a dispute with Coors Brewing Co after a court ruling terminated their previous agreement and the Canadian brewer has also undertaken a major restructuring programme.
Millers Brewing Co, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc, owns 20 percent of Molson Breweries and the other 40 percent is owned by Molson Cos Ltd.
